# Hexagon Asset Lifecycle Intelligence Resources

> Central hub for Hexagon's Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division featuring resources on BIM, Digital Twins, and enterprise asset management solutions.

Hexagon ALI provides comprehensive resources for digital transformation in asset management, manufacturing, and industrial facilities. The platform showcases integrated solutions for Smart Digital Reality and connected worker ecosystems.

- Digital Twins
- BIM (Building Information Modeling)
- Smart Digital Reality
- HXGN SDX2
- HXGN EAM
- Asset Management
- Digital Transformation
- Connected Worker Ecosystem
- AcceleratorKMS
- Manufacturing
- Industrial Facilities
